# Browser checks

- Verify the page URL and relevant account before acting.
- Assert the actual visible control or result after JavaScript initializes.
- Test the path a user depends on, including its submitted value or saved state.
- Reload or reopen to check persistence when persistence is part of the request.
- Capture an actual screenshot and note the tested revision.
- For authenticated work, use only the account/profile granted to this computer.
  Shared Team browser profiles are shared with that team, not private role vaults.
- A login screen, HTTP 200, screenshot or finished tool call alone does not prove
  that the requested business operation succeeded.
